summary: Precision BioSciences filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing an underwritten registered equity offering priced November 5, 2026. The company sold 10,235,077 common shares at $7.75 per share plus, in lieu of stock for certain investors, pre-funded warrants for up to 5,893,964 shares at $7.749995 each (strike $0.000005). Net proceeds are estimated at approximately $116.5 million, excluding warrant exercise proceeds, under an effective Form S-3 shelf. TD Securities and Guggenheim Securities acted as representatives. This is an ordinary shelf takedown rather than a special situation; watch offering overhang and pre-funded warrant dilution.
